compatibility: Existing UI groups NO_EDGE under Watchlist; canonical opportunity_status distinguishes it. No page/component changes.
latestRows: Deterministic timestamp/identity ordering; values per prediction and side; exact mapping and observation linkage; no older-value fallback behind new predictions or new markets
supersession: Recompute active blockers only from the selected current evidence; immutable historical rows are preserved
limitations: No claim that current production evidence is fresh: the later prediction-stage automation failure is outside R10 and remains preserved.
Public evidence is aggregate-only. Detailed game matrix and source payloads remain private for readback and the user report.
No UI redesign or component implementation is included.
